correctness.rationale: Every inter-fiber geodesic projects to the unique path in the base tree, and each interior fiber can be traversed without selected interiors exactly when it has an omitted vertex. The Steiner hull consequently characterizes all visible sets. Both necessary and sufficient maximality arguments force full leaf fibers, exactly one omission per internal fiber, and no external neighbor of an internal base vertex. This gives an injective and surjective correspondence; interval enumeration yields the path coefficients and arithmetic gaps. A direct graph-level program matched 214 instances and 185798 enumerated subsets; these finite tests corroborate, not replace, the proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A result on maximum mutual visibility or minimum cardinality among maximal sets cannot recover coefficients of all maximal-set sizes. The 2022 strong-product work supplies context, not a broader maximal-set enumeration theorem in inspected material.

value.rationale: A natural weighted tree-of-cliques family receives a complete maximal mutual-visibility set correspondence and exact labeled cardinality enumerator. The uniform clique-path special case is a connected unit interval family with cardinality support in an arithmetic progression of gap m-1, yielding arbitrarily long missing intervals and exact multiplicities. These are structural and size-distribution facts not implied by scalar extremal invariants; the full weighted theorem includes nonuniform clique sizes.
